Alongside my academic research, I lead and contribute to policy-oriented research and evaluations at the Centre for Economic Research (SØF), NTNU Social Research. My commissioned research combines quantitative analyses, interviews and institutional knowledge to provide evidence for Norwegian public authorities.

Below is a selection of research reports to which I have contributed, organised by topic. Original Norwegian report titles are retained, with links to the publications or relevant institutional repositories.

## Resource allocation and school funding

::: {.publication}
**[Ressurstildelingsmodell i Møre og Romsdal](https://samforsk.no/publikasjoner/nr-6-22-ressurstildelingsmodell-i-more-og-romsdal)** (2022)  
Analysis of expenditure needs and funding formulas for upper secondary schools, including provision for students with additional educational needs.
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Vurdering av nivået på trekkordningen for elever i frittstående skoler](https://samforsk.no/uploads/files/Publikasjoner/Vurdering-av-nivaet-pa-trekkordningen-for-elever-i-frittstaende-skoler-WEB.pdf)** (2021)  
Analysis of the deductions from municipal and county authority budgets associated with pupils attending independent schools.
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Ressurstildelingsmodell i Trøndelag fylkeskommune](https://samforsk.no/publikasjoner/nr-2-17-ressurstildelingsmodell-i-trondelag-fylkeskommune)** (SØF Report 2/17)  
Simulation and assessment of funding models for upper secondary schools in connection with the merger of the two Trøndelag counties.
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Kostnader ved skoleskyss](https://samforsk.no/publikasjoner/nr-3-15-kostnader-ved-skoleskyss)** (2015)  
An investigation of county authorities' school transport costs and the factors driving expenditure needs.
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Evaluering av landslinjeordningen](https://samforsk.no/uploads/files/Publikasjoner/SOF-R-02_15.pdf)** (2015)  
Evaluation of the organisation and funding of nationally designated upper secondary programmes.
:::

## Teacher qualifications and recruitment

These reports explore teacher qualifications, differences between statistical sources and challenges in recruiting teachers across schools and regions.

::: {.publication}
**[Hvem er lærerne uten lærerutdanning?](https://samforsk.no/uploads/files/NTNU-Samf-SOFrapport-Lererne-uten-lererutdanning.pdf)** (2024)  
A study of teachers without formal teaching qualifications, focusing on their subject knowledge and pedagogical training. [NTNU Social Research – news](https://samforsk.no/nyheter/har-studert-laerere-uten-laererutdanning).
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Rekruttering av lærere ved norske skoler](https://nva.sikt.no/registration/0198cc5882ba-bba18ee8-ea0a-4ca1-a891-6b697ce172e4)** (2023)  
A study of the teacher labour market and the challenges schools face in recruiting qualified teachers. [NTNU Social Research – news](https://samforsk.no/nyheter/vanskeligst-a-rekruttere-laerere-for-de-yngste-elevene).
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Ulikheter i lærerstatistikk](https://samforsk.no/uploads/files/Ulikheter-i-laererstatistikk-WEB.pdf)** (2021)  
A comparison of data sources and definitions to explain differences in estimates of teacher qualifications. [NTNU Social Research – news](https://samforsk.no/nyheter/kronikk-forskjellige-laererstatistikker-gir-ulikt-inntrykk-av-kvalifikasjoner-i-skolen).
:::

## Labour markets, integration and regional development

::: {.publication}
**[Kartlegging og vurdering av kommunale næringsfond i Øst-Finnmark](https://nva.sikt.no/registration/01a1a14fcd4b-2c8d8d70-d329-431e-a3ac-c1de12de7a46)** (2026)  
Analysis of how municipalities administer and use business development funds, and their contribution to local economic development. [NTNU Social Research – project](https://samforsk.no/prosjekter/kartlegging-og-vurdering-av-kommunale-naeringsfond-i-ost-finnmark).
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Evaluering av tilskudd til utvikling av kvalifiserings- og integreringstiltak](https://nva.sikt.no/registration/019b221b1342-a65fd81d-c7e5-4ad9-8aa6-1c6ac849327b)** (2025)  
Evaluation of the grant scheme supporting municipal initiatives to improve immigrants' skills and integration. [NTNU Social Research – project](https://samforsk.no/prosjekter/evatuki).
:::

::: {.publication}
**[Tjenestereisen i helseaksen – en helhetlig undersøkelse av NAVs oppfølging av arbeidstakere med helseutfordringer](https://nva.sikt.no/registration/0198cc461645-7f712145-52e4-407b-b268-cb9874eb7ed7)** (2024)

:::

::: {.publication}
**[Arbeids- og næringslivet i Trøndelag i en tid med pandemi og smitteverntiltak](https://samforsk.no/uploads/files/SOF-rapport-Utviklingen-i-trondersk-naeringsliv.pdf)** (2020)

Since 2014, I have also contributed to Norges Bank's Regional Network through regular business interviews and analysis of economic developments in Trøndelag.

See also [my NTNU Social Research profile](https://samforsk.no/ansatte/jon-marius-vaag-iversen) and [SØF's publications archive](https://samforsk.no/senter-for-okonomisk-forskning/publikasjoner) for additional reports and projects.
